mechanism_assessment.observation: The trailing-U+000A candidate is accepted by Python re.match with ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ because $ may match before a final newline, while re.fullmatch rejects the same 65-character string.
mechanism_assessment.inference: Exact reconstruction identity validation should use a full-string primitive or explicit length-plus-character-set predicate rather than an unqualified $ end anchor when fail-closed newline handling matters.
mechanism_assessment.unverified: Other regex engines/modes, trailing CR/CRLF and other whitespace, more than two records, concurrency, crash/rollback durability, digest collisions and producer interoperability remain untested.
